summary: This directory provides specialized collection data structures, specifically a MultiMap implementation, designed to manage key-value pairs where a single key can be associated with multiple distinct values.
responsibilities: Implement and maintain specialized data structures for complex data mapping
Ensure consistent behavior and reliability of collection utilities through comprehensive testing
relationships: The MultiMap serves as a collection utility that extends standard map functionality by allowing multiple values for each key.
designDecisions: Encapsulating collection logic within a dedicated module
Testing driven development to ensure data integrity of complex collection structures
